steps.summary: Signed in to the Repair Desk app at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ as bench@example.com, then created a ticket titled 'fwrd66-n3 RD Bench Ticket' via the "New ticket" dialog. The new ticket appears at the top of the tickets table as RD-1017 (Status: Draft, Customer: Not recorded, 0 parts, created 2026-09-17), confirming creation.

On ticket RD-1017 I added two parts via the "Add part" dialog. After the parts table refreshed, Part A ('fwrd66-n3 RD Part A', cost $100.00, markup 25%) shows a computed price of $125.00, and Part B ('fwrd66-n3 RD Part B', cost $200.00, markup 25%) shows a computed price of $250.00; the table's "Total (price × quantity)" row reads $375.00, consistent with the two rows.

On ticket RD-1017 I opened the Edit dialog for part 'fwrd66-n3 RD Part A', changed Cost from 100 to 150 (markup left at 25%), and saved. The parts table refreshed in place: the row now reads $150.00 cost, 25% markup, $187.50 price, and the total row updated to $437.50.
